MY26 model claims are source-attributed and do not upgrade the importer shop product 8051, whose raw title/specifications remain MY25. No MY25, legacy non-HP, off-road X or overseas technical values transfer to these offers.

EBMX advertises AUD 10,490 for each selected offer. GST and on-road-cost inclusion are not verified. The NSW-only AUD 995 dealer registration-related add-on is not an itemized ORC quote; neither amount nor their sum is a verified driveaway total. Freight quote and delivery commitment are unknown.

24.5 kW is short-burst Turbo peak; 21.5 kW is a separate dealer-image Sports maximum. Continuous/rated output is unknown. Importer 520 Nm has unspecified shaft/wheel basis; EBMX separately describes rear-wheel torque. No motor-shaft comparison.

74 V / 60 Ah / 4,440 Wh are published pack declarations, not measured usable energy or an explicitly labelled nominal/gross value. Cell subtype and exact component revision remain unverified. No derived capacity is promoted.

2.5 hours is the importer 20–80% SOC claim only. MY26 full-charge time, supplied charger output/current/AC input/connector/model are unknown. Charger inclusion/compliance is a conditional importer-wide statement; storage and upgrade-ready interface do not establish charger rating or exact packing list.

General importer 12 months and exact EBMX one-year non-transferable warranty claims remain qualified. Component terms, kilometre cap, service conditions, degradation threshold and commercial-use cover are not closed. The 1,500-cycle/>80% battery-life claim is not warranty coverage.

T/R dimensions and clearance remain conflicted; R wet/curb mass is unresolved. T 91 kg retains source-specific wet/curb basis. T rear tyre 100/90-18 versus 100/19-18 remains unresolved. EBMX commerce 123 kg and 176×46×100 cm have no identified basis and are not bike or packaging specifications.
